draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.19, the 98th-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 12th of 31 at WR. He lasted until pick 166, well after his grade rank (98th): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 353 receiving yards in 2024, 30th of 31 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Seattle Seahawks. 8 career games and 3 starts over 1 completed season, plus 3 so far in 2026. Still developing: 2 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: receiving td 5 (76th percentile). Weak spots: receiving yards 161 (25th percentile). Played 8 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-1 wide receiver who played: 161 receiving yards against a median of 198, below the norm.
